verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents an AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using logs, metrics, traces, errors, and web events, and it can suggest root-cause fixes through Linear tickets and GitHub PRs. However, the evidence shows the agent being invoked on demand (tagging @betterstack, calling it from Slack, Teams, or MCP) rather than starting an investigation automatically before a human asks. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive or automatic investigation on incident creation, correlation with recent changes or deploys, matching against similar past incidents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
